info.name: AhmedAlhajji Mobile App API (Frontend)
info.description:
# Mobile App API Collection (Frontend Developers)

> **Important:** In this project, **Frontend = Mobile App** only.
> **Dashboard = Admin panel** (separate). Dashboard/Admin APIs are **NOT** in this collection.

## Who is this for?
Give this file to your **mobile app / frontend developer** so they can see which API belongs to which app screen.

## Base URLs // example
- Local: `http://localhost:2002/api/v1`
- Production: change `serverUrl` variable

## Folder → App Screen Map
| Folder | App Screen / Feature |
|--------|---------------------|
| Auth & Onboarding | Sign up, OTP, Login |
| Password Recovery | Forgot password flow |
| User Profile | Profile view & edit |
| Pricing & Plans | Subscription plans list, plan details, trial promo info |
| Coupon (Checkout) | Validate discount code before payment |
| Purchase & My Plan | Paywall, Stripe checkout, active subscription |
| Posts | Market news feed, comments, likes & shares |
| Notifications | Bell icon, unread badge, alerts list |
| History | Closed signals, performance overview, filters |
| Legal Pages | Privacy, Terms, About (read-only) |

## Purchase flow (App)
1. Login User
2. Get All Subscription Plans → save `subscriptionId`
3. Validate Coupon (optional) → e.g. ELITE50 // example
4. Initiate Purchase → open `checkoutUrl` in app (Stripe)
5. After Stripe payment, backend webhook activates subscription automatically
6. Call **Get Current Active Subscription** to refresh UI

item.name: Purchase & My Plan
item.description:
App screens: Paywall, Stripe Payment, My Subscription, Purchase History

Suggested flow:
1. Login User
2. Get All Subscription Plans → save {{subscriptionId}}
3. Initiate Paid Purchase or Free Trial
4. Get Current Active Subscription

item.name: Get All Subscription Plans
item.description:
Screen: Paywall / Choose Plan before purchase

Returns all active plans (VIP, Forex, Crypto) with price, features, billing options.

Public — no auth required. Saves first plan id to {{subscriptionId}}.

item.name: Get Subscription Plan By ID
item.description:
Screen: Plan details before checkout

Use {{subscriptionId}} from Get All Subscription Plans.

item.name: Initiate Paid Purchase (With Coupon)
item.description:
Screen: Checkout → Pay with Stripe

Body // example:
- subscriptionId: from Get All Plans
- isFreeTrial: false
- couponCode: WELCOME20
- billingCycle: monthly

Response:
- checkoutUrl → open in app WebView/browser
- paymentRequired: true → wait for Stripe, then refresh current subscription

item.name: Initiate Free Trial
item.description:
Screen: Start Free Trial button

Body // example:
- subscriptionId: plan id
- isFreeTrial: true
- billingCycle: monthly

item.name: Posts
item.description:
App screens: Posts feed (empty + list), post detail, comments thread, like/share actions.

Requires **active subscription** (premium content).

Suggested flow:
1. Login User
2. Get Posts Feed → saves {{postId}}
3. Get Post Detail
4. Get Post Comments → saves {{commentId}}
5. Add Comment / Edit / Delete Comment
6. Toggle Like Post / Toggle Like Comment / Share Post

item.name: Get Posts Feed
item.description:
Screen: Posts home — scrollable cards with category badge, author, likes/comments/shares.

Query params // example:
- page=1, limit=10
- category=Education | Market Update | News | All
- search=bitcoin

Saves first comment id to {{commentId}}.

item.name: Add Comment
item.description: Screen: "Write a comment..." input + send.

item.name: Edit Comment
item.description:
Screen: Edit own comment (only comment owner).

item.name: Delete Comment
item.description:
Screen: Delete own comment (only comment owner).

item.name: Toggle Post Like
item.description:
Screen: Heart icon on post card.

Single toggle API — no body needed.
Already liked → unlikes. Not liked → likes.

Response: { isLiked, likesCount }

item.name: Toggle Comment Like
Share Post

item.name: Notifications
item.description:
App screen: Bell icon tab — alerts list with unread badge.

Suggested flow:
1. Login User
2. Get Unread Count → badge on bell icon
3. Get Notifications → saves {{notificationId}}
4. Mark Notification Read / Mark All Read

item.description:

item.name: Mark All Notifications Read

- search=NAS (asset search)
- page=1, limit=10
